name: Kamiyama (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kamiyama town emblem in white: a ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised numeral 7.
history: Municipal flag of Kamiyama, a town in Tokushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 November 1965.

features.role: Kamiyama town emblem — a ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised numeral 7
